name: Office 365 - Azure Active Directory - Transactions by Client Location

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Office365 CreationTime ClientIP "\"Workload\":\"AzureActiveDirectory\""
| json "Workload"
| json "ClientIP"  as src_ip
| where Workload = "AzureActiveDirectory"
| count by src_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code from geo://location on ip = src_ip
| where !isNull(latitude)
